thread:
Nadia: quick heads-up: onboarding helion-22B-int4 canary. After a handful of long-form requests we saw two coldstart OOMs and a p99 slowgen spike. dropping logs + current defaults.
Ishan: paste the runtime snippet? want to see if its a KV window prefault or a workspace burst.
Nadia: log snip:
```
E 01:42:18 oom: failed alloc workspace (req=400MB)
W 01:42:18 slab: fragmented=true free_chunks=8 largest=36MB
I 01:42:19 kv_cache: size=970MB autotrim=disabled
```
Becky: looks like fragmentation + a single large workspace alloc when max_new_tokens combined with batching. What defaults did we push?
Nadia: canary defaults:
```
model: helion-22B-int4
max_new_tokens: 800
batch_size: 5
kv_prefetch: eager
reserve_mb: 0
microbatch: off
```
Ron: 800+5 on shared slots will bite. Two quick mitigations: reduce max_new_tokens to 320, batch_size to 3, enable microbatching (2), and set reserve_mb to 200. Also switch kv_prefetch to "lazy" for the first 10% of canary.
Ishan: add runtime-level guard: if workspace_alloc > 300MB then fail-fast with fallback route to helion-19B-compat. That prevents repeated fragmentation churn.
Becky: also set slab_reclaim_interval_sec=4 to encourage compaction during canary waves.
Nadia: updated canary proposal:
```
{
  \"model\": \"helion-22B-int4\",
  \"defaults\": {
    \"max_new_tokens\": 320,
    \"batch_size\": 3,
    \"microbatching\": true,
    \"microbatch_size\": 2,
    \"kv_prefetch\": \"lazy\",
    \"reserve_mb\": 200,
    \"slab_reclaim_interval_sec\": 4,
    \"soft_fallback_policy\": \"workspace_alloc>300MB => helion-19B-compat\"
  }
}
```
ops-bot: canary deploy started by Nadia -> helion-22B-int4 @ 3% with revised defaults. Monitoring: p95/p99, oom_count, kv_evictions, workspace_alloc.
Ishan: also run a quick quant comparison: int8 clone of this model seems promising on latency but historically has worse tail behavior for long-context. Schedule a microbench against int8 tomorrow.
Becky: small synthetic after change (5k requests): p95 -19%, p99 -14%, mem headroom +260MB, OOMs 0/45m, quality delta (ROUGE) -0.3% vs fp16.
Nadia: quality hit acceptable for default traffic. For dedicated long-form customers we'll offer pinned helion-22B-dedicated or allow higher max_new_tokens with slot reservation. Action items: 1) update model-catalog defaults (Nadia), 2) add soft-fallback rule (Ishan), 3) schedule int8 bench (Ron), 4) monitor 2h soak (Becky).
rt-bot: canary @3% -> 10% (monitoring) :thumbsup:
Nadia: after 2h soak: zero OOMs, p99 stabilized, fallback never triggered. Moving canary to 30% and posting a short runbook to #eng-ml with rollback steps (pin routes, revert defaults). Thanks all :tada:
